claims.text: Verify results
claims.note: Verification is the push service's read-back comparison.

claims.text: Confirming Lynx accepted every adjustment.
claims.note: A run ends as Complete only when no station's read-back value differs from what was sent.

claims.text: A push is four phases, not one.
claims.note: The working steps are Pushing, Fetching, Verifying and Retrying, each with its own status line (SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_PUSHING, _RETRIEVING, _VERIFYING and _RETRYING). Errors and Complete are outcomes rather than phases.

claims.text: Knowing them tells you what a slow run is waiting for.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (verify-results/summary/2); docs/text-corrections.md §19 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Knowing them tells you whether a slow run is working or stuck.

claims.text: Push progress dialog
claims.note: The progress dialog's header is the literal "Pushing Changes To Lynx", passed through the translate pipe with no catalogue key behind it, so every locale shows the English.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: The push progress window, just after you select the footer button of the [[Push Changes]] dialog.
claims.note: The progress window opens when the footer button of the Push Changes dialog is used. Reworded from verify-results/where/1.

claims.text: Lynx must be reachable, and Site Adjust and Course Adjust must both be 100% in Lynx.
claims.note: Lynx must be reachable, and Site Adjust and Course Adjust must be 100% in Lynx. Reworded from push-to-lynx/before/4, push-to-lynx/before/1.

claims.text: Verification is automatic.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The read-back is requested automatically when the write loop completes, and the comparison runs when it arrives. The user does nothing.

claims.text: You do not have to check Lynx by hand to know whether a push landed.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. For every station Lynx reports back, the dialog ends with either success or a failure count. Three limits, none of which contradicts the sentence. A station missing from Lynx's reply is counted as matched (sa-push-changes.service.ts:78). If the read-back itself fails, the dialog closes with no result and only a Lynx error toast, and then the reader does not know whether the push landed. The check is against Lynx, not the course: whether a push made outside the push window reaches the course is Q3 in docs/claims/operational-contract.md.

claims.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 lists the Lynx settings Spatial Adjust depends on: Site Adjust and Course Adjust, Pct. Adjust, and Next Amt.

claims.text: Push changes to Lynx lists the settings under Before you start.
claims.note: Cross-reference within the guides: push-to-lynx/before/4 to /before/9 carry the settings, each from 373-1135 rev 02 §Settings Configuration, p.1.

claims.text: It writes first, station by station
claims.note: Transform 12 is in place and correct on production. The push handler goes straight into the write loop.

claims.text: Watch the line under the progress bar as each station is written.
claims.note: The line under the bar names the phase. Reworded from verify-results/1/3, verify-results/1/6.

claims.text: It reads Pushing Percent Adjustments to Lynx with a count, such as 4 of 6, and the bar fills at a steady pace.
claims.note: The first phase reads Pushing Percent Adjustments to Lynx, with a count (en-us.json:415). Reworded from verify-results/1/3, verify-results/1/6.

claims.text: If the bar seems slow on a large course, that is normal: each station takes at least a tenth of a second.
claims.note: Each write takes at least a tenth of a second. Reworded from verify-results/1/4.

claims.text: This phase cannot stall, because its count runs on a timer and does not wait for Lynx.
claims.note: The write count runs on a timer, so the stall risk is in the later phases. Reworded from verify-results/1/4, verify-results/1/5.

claims.text: Phase one: writing, four of six.
claims.note: Figure caption. "Pushing Percent Adjustments to Lynx (4 of 6)".

claims.text: Push window. Push between 11 AM and the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and synchronise Lynx after the push.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.10 gives the window, 11 AM to the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and says to synchronise after the push. It names no time zone and does not say how to synchronise. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q1 and Q2 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md): is the 11 AM in the course's local time or US Eastern Time, and does the synchronisation Lynx runs at its scheduled time pick up an earlier push, or must the superintendent synchronise Lynx by hand after every push?

claims.text: Outside that window the push does not reach the course, and no error tells you so.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 gives the window but never says what happens outside it, and IntelliDash has no push-window logic. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q3 and Q4: does a push made after the Lynx synchronisation time, or before 11 AM, fail to reach the course, and does anything in Spatial Adjust or Lynx report it? (The push dialog would still verify the values against Lynx and report success.)

claims.text: Then it reads Lynx back
claims.note: The read is issued from the write loop's completion handler.

claims.text: Look for [[Retrieving latest Percent Adjustments from Lynx for comparison]] under the bar.
claims.note: The second phase reads Retrieving latest Percent Adjustments from Lynx for comparison (en-us.json:416). Reworded from verify-results/2/2, verify-results/2/4.

claims.text: The bar holds still while Spatial Adjust reads back what Lynx now holds.
claims.note: The read-back is a single request, so the bar holds. Reworded from verify-results/2/3, verify-results/2/4.

claims.text: If the run stalls here, Spatial Adjust is waiting for Lynx to answer.
claims.note: A stall happens while Spatial Adjust waits for Lynx. Reworded from verify-results/1/5.

claims.text: If it never moves on, check the connection to Lynx.
claims.note: Lynx must be reachable for the read-back. Reworded from verify-results/1/5, push-to-lynx/before/1.

claims.text: Phase two: reading back what Lynx now holds.
claims.note: Figure caption. SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_RETRIEVING "Retrieving latest Percent Adjustments from Lynx for comparison".

claims.text: Then it verifies
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_VERIFYING "Verifying adjustments sent to Lynx".

claims.text: Look for [[Verifying adjustments sent to Lynx]] under the bar.
claims.note: The third phase reads Verifying adjustments sent to Lynx (en-us.json:419). Reworded from verify-results/3/1, verify-results/3/4.

claims.text: The bar moves forward while each value sent is checked against what Lynx now reports.
claims.note: Each value is compared with what Lynx reports. Reworded from verify-results/3/2, verify-results/3/4.

claims.text: If a value does not match, the station is treated as failed, and the next phase retries it.
claims.note: A mismatch is treated as failed and retried. Reworded from verify-results/3/3, verify-results/4/1.

claims.text: Phase three: comparing what Lynx reports against what was sent.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Failures are retried automatically
claims.note: Retries start without any action from the user.

claims.text: Watch for the bar to drop back to 0.
claims.note: The fourth phase restarts the bar at zero. Reworded from verify-results/4/4, verify-results/4/3.

claims.text: The bar restarts at zero and counts only the stations being retried, and the line says how many.
claims.note: The retry pass counts only the failed stations, and the line names how many (en-us.json:417). Reworded from verify-results/4/4, verify-results/4/3.

claims.text: If the bar drops from nearly full to 0, that is the retry starting, not the push failing.
claims.note: The drop to zero is the retry starting. Reworded from verify-results/4/4.

claims.text: Each failed station is tried up to 2 more times before the result is shown.
claims.note: Failed stations get up to two further attempts (push-changes.service.ts:30). Reworded from verify-results/4/2, verify-results/4/1.

claims.text: Phase four: retrying the stations that did not verify.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Read the outcome
claims.note: The result template replaces the progress bar when processing completes.

claims.text: Read the result line above [[Close]].
claims.note: The result line sits above the Close button. Reworded from verify-results/5/1, verify-results/5/2.

claims.text: It reads [[All selected changes successfully pushed to Lynx.]]
claims.note: The success line is LYNX_PUSH_SUCCESS (en-us.json:418). Reworded from verify-results/5/4.

claims.text: If it names stations that could not be updated, select [[Close]] and follow Push failures.
claims.note: A failure names the stations that could not be updated. Reworded from push-to-lynx/6/3, push-to-lynx/6/4.

claims.text: Success means every change was read back from Lynx and matched what was sent.
claims.note: Success follows the read-back and comparison. Reworded from verify-results/5/2, verify-results/3/2.

claims.text: All selected changes pushed and verified.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: The dialog reported success rather than a failure count.
claims.note: The result is either SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_SUCCESS or SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_ERROR with the failed-station count. A read-back failure shows neither (see verify-results/summary/2).

claims.text: Push Changes no longer counts the stations you sent, and the pushed-today counter increased.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (verify-results/verify/2); docs/text-corrections.md §16 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The pending count is zero and the pushed-today counter increased.
